Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>visible</p><div style="font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)"><span style="line-height:0">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
